# Vendored libraries

## three.js

- Version: 0.170.0
- Files: `three.module.js`, `loaders/GLTFLoader.js`, `utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js`
- License: MIT (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/dev/LICENSE)
- Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

These files are vendored so the Rubber Duck UI can run with **no CDN** at runtime.
